sourceSeries.numeratorDescription: Number of transactions containing at least one output of a BRK locking-script type. Each transaction is counted once per type; the `all` aggregate counts every transaction, including coinbase. Uses pay-to-Taproot outputs. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.
sourceSeries.denominatorDescription: Number of transactions, including the coinbase transaction. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.

limitations: Taproot share means the percentage of transactions creating at least one P2TR output, with each transaction counted once.
The source all-aggregate and the denominator both include coinbase transactions.
This is not the share of transactions that spend a P2TR output.
Hosted Bitview metric data do not have a separately verified reuse license. These rows remain private and local.
